leads.name: Mulberry, New Place Great Garden
leads.reason: PROMOTED to sua_001 in data/research/stratford-upon-avon-verified.json (SBT page, 'around 270 years'). The earlier note about an 1862 planting was wrong: 1862 is the date of a chair. The 1969 Peggy Ashcroft mulberry in the same garden is a second tree of the same site, not a separate point (split in 2013).
